intro: St. Kevin's is more than football. Our clubhouse and grounds are home to activities for every age and interest — and everyone in the community is welcome, member or not.

activities.title: Saints Bar and Restaurant
activities.when: Now open — see socials for hours
activities.description: Our clubhouse restaurant and bar is now open. Drop in after training, watch the match, or book a table for a family occasion. Available for parties and private events.

activities.title: Bowls
activities.when: Weekly in the clubhouse hall (times TBC)
activities.description: Indoor bowls in the hall — a great social evening and open to all levels. New players are always welcome; equipment provided.

activities.title: Pilates
activities.description: Evening Pilates classes in the clubhouse. Suitable for beginners and improvers — bring a mat and book your spot.

activities.title: Darts
activities.when: Boards in Saints Bar — league nights TBC
activities.description: St. Kevin's has its own darts team, and the boards in Saints Bar and Restaurant are open to everyone. Fancy a game, or want to join the team for league nights? Ask at the bar.

activities.title: Club Walkway
activities.description: Our 1.2km floodlit walkway around the grounds is free and open to the whole community every day. Buggy and wheelchair friendly.

activities.title: Gaelic4Mothers&Others
activities.description: Non-competitive football, fitness and fun for mothers and others — no experience needed, all fitness levels welcome.
